1580-4871-5670-6772.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-6772.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Syr Vondam and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-2279-4247-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

728-2730-3175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4396-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4396-4871-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1987-2493-4668.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2493-4668.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-2493-4668.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4668.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1987-6259-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-6259-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-6259-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1169-2590-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

2544-5116-5390.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {1}{U} due to Forensic Gadgeteer, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

5231-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2173-5220-6537-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

339-677-1251-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

290-1680-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Dreamstone Hedron's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2281-6125-6797.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Fiendish Panda.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fiendish Panda.
When Fiendish Panda dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Fiendish Panda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fiendish Panda trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1477-4112-6767.description:
Cast Rescue Skiff by paying {5}{W}.
When Rescue Skiff enter the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sharuum.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Rescue Skiff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

880-1659-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-1659-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

813-2104-5530.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Another Round.
813-2104-5530.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

509-2750-2904-6499.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax if applicable
509-2750-2904-6499.notablePrerequisites:
The top card of your library has a higher mana value than the top cards of each opponent's library.
You have a way to choose one or more targets, as well as additional legal targets for that spell or ability.
509-2750-2904-6499.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Psychic Battle to become an artifact.
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Psychic Battle until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Choose any number of targets by any method.
Idris triggers, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist and Idris trigger.
Resolve the Cephalid Illusionist trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing each player to reveal the top card of their library and changing the target(s) of the spell or ability to any other target.
Repeat from step 5.
509-2750-2904-6499.notes: You may use Memnarch to select a target if mana allows.

1445-4871-5231-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5231-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1987-4276-4477-4823.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-4276-4477-4823.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa and Timeless Witness.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4477-4823.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

3821-3967-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
3821-3967-5140.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

1447-2719-5147.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1262-4221.description:
Living Plane cause all lands to be 1/1 creatures in addition to their other types.
Because Drana and Linvala prevents your opponents from activating abilities of creatures they control, your opponents cannot activate abilities of lands or creatures they control.

659-1864-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
659-1864-2178.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Prossh by sacrificing a Goblin token.
The Goblin dies, triggering Krenko, untapping Krenko.
Resolve the Prossh ability, giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

328-387-2693-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: Gray Merchant in hand.You control less than two Thrulls.
328-387-2693-4050-4871.description:
Cast Gray Merchant by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least four life and you to gain life equal to the life you gained this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing Gray Merchant and five Thrulls, adding {3}{B}{B}{B}.
The Thrulls and Grey Merchant die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer six times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and two life, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

215-2456-4050-5031.notablePrerequisites: Skitterbeam Batallion in hand.You control at least nine artifacts.
215-2456-4050-5031.description:
Cast Skitterbeam Batallion by paying {0}.
Skitterbeam Batallion enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the two Skitterbeam Batallion tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Skitterbeam Batallion from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2694-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
2694-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Gavony Unhallowed triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3389-3809.description:
Cast Flickering Ward for {W}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward for {W}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

1369-3990-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-3990-3995.description:
Activate Quicksilver Elemental twice by paying {U}{U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Incubation Druid and Horseshoe Crab until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-5021-5261.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Noxious Revival without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Noxious Revival, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
